name: Charles Town Races Hollywood Casino
skip_reason: Casino overnight parking lot, not a campground - verified rather than skipped on the name, and RV Life's avg_rate of 0 checks out. Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races offers FREE overnight RV/truck parking in a dedicated paved lot west of the west parking garage: no numbered sites, no hookups, no published nightly rate, no check-in, and casino security moves rigs on after about three nights. Campendium, Allstays, RVParky and Casino Camper all describe it as a park-and-stay lot rather than a campground, and no separate campground exists on the property.
